1	import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest'
2	import { RateLimiter } from '../src/RateLimiter.js'
3	
4	function makeClock(start = 1_000_000) {
5	  let t = start
6	  return {
7	    now: () => t,
8	    advance: (ms: number) => {
9	      t += ms
10	    },
11	    set: (ms: number) => {
12	      t = ms
13	    },
14	  }
15	}
16	
17	describe('RateLimiter — construction', () => {
18	  it('rejects non-positive max', () => {
19	    expect(() => new RateLimiter({ max: 0, windowMs: 1000, mode: 'fixed' })).toThrow()
20	    expect(() => new RateLimiter({ max: -1, windowMs: 1000, mode: 'fixed' })).toThrow()
21	  })
22	
23	  it('rejects non-positive windowMs', () => {
24	    expect(() => new RateLimiter({ max: 5, windowMs: 0, mode: 'fixed' })).toThrow()
25	    expect(() => new RateLimiter({ max: 5, windowMs: -100, mode: 'fixed' })).toThrow()
26	  })
27	
28	  it('rejects invalid mode', () => {
29	    expect(
30	      () => new RateLimiter({ max: 5, windowMs: 1000, mode: 'bogus' as unknown as 'fixed' }),
31	    ).toThrow()
32	  })
33	})
34	
35	describe('RateLimiter — fixed mode', () => {
36	  it('allows up to max calls within a window then denies', () => {
37	    const clock = makeClock()
38	    const limiter = new RateLimiter({ max: 5, windowMs: 1000, mode: 'fixed', now: clock.now })
39	
40	    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
41	      expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(true)
42	    }
43	    expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(false)
44	  })
45	
46	  it('resets capacity after the window ends', () => {
47	    const clock = makeClock()
48	    const limiter = new RateLimiter({ max: 2, windowMs: 1000, mode: 'fixed', now: clock.now })
49	
50	    expect(limiter.allow('a')).toBe(true)
51	    expect(limiter.allow('a')).toBe(true)
52	    expect(limiter.allow('a')).toBe(false)
53	
54	    clock.advance(1000)
55	    expect(limiter.allow('a')).toBe(true)
56	    expect(limiter.allow('a')).toBe(true)
57	    expect(limiter.allow('a')).toBe(false)
58	  })
59	
60	  it('does not reset early mid-window even if many calls come in', () => {
61	    const clock = makeClock()
62	    const limiter = new RateLimiter({ max: 3, windowMs: 1000, mode: 'fixed', now: clock.now })
63	
64	    expect(limiter.allow('k')).toBe(true)
65	    clock.advance(400)
66	    expect(limiter.allow('k')).toBe(true)
67	    clock.advance(400)
68	    expect(limiter.allow('k')).toBe(true)
69	    clock.advance(100) // total 900ms < 1000ms, still same window
70	    expect(limiter.allow('k')).toBe(false)
71	  })
72	
73	  it('tracks keys independently', () => {
74	    const clock = makeClock()
75	    const limiter = new RateLimiter({ max: 1, windowMs: 1000, mode: 'fixed', now: clock.now })
76	
77	    expect(limiter.allow('a')).toBe(true)
78	    expect(limiter.allow('b')).toBe(true)
79	    expect(limiter.allow('a')).toBe(false)
80	    expect(limiter.allow('b')).toBe(false)
81	  })
82	})
83	
84	describe('RateLimiter — sliding mode', () => {
85	  it('allows up to max calls within trailing window then denies', () => {
86	    const clock = makeClock()
87	    const limiter = new RateLimiter({ max: 5, windowMs: 1000, mode: 'sliding', now: clock.now })
88	
89	    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
90	      expect(limiter.allow('u')).toBe(true)
91	    }
92	    clock.advance(500)
93	    expect(limiter.allow('u')).toBe(false)
94	  })
95	
96	  it('lets calls through as older ones age out', () => {
97	    const clock = makeClock(0)
98	    const limiter = new RateLimiter({ max: 5, windowMs: 1000, mode: 'sliding', now: clock.now })
99	
100	    // 5 calls at t=0
101	    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
102	      expect(limiter.allow('u')).toBe(true)
103	    }
104	    clock.set(500)
105	    expect(limiter.allow('u')).toBe(false)
106	    clock.set(1100)
107	    // first call at t=0 aged out (cutoff = 100), 5th call still in window
108	    expect(limiter.allow('u')).toBe(true)
109	  })
110	
111	  it('tracks sliding keys independently', () => {
112	    const clock = makeClock()
113	    const limiter = new RateLimiter({ max: 2, windowMs: 1000, mode: 'sliding', now: clock.now })
114	
115	    expect(limiter.allow('a')).toBe(true)
116	    expect(limiter.allow('a')).toBe(true)
117	    expect(limiter.allow('b')).toBe(true)
118	    expect(limiter.allow('a')).toBe(false)
119	    expect(limiter.allow('b')).toBe(true)
120	    expect(limiter.allow('b')).toBe(false)
121	  })
122	
123	  it('fully restores capacity once all timestamps age out', () => {
124	    const clock = makeClock(0)
125	    const limiter = new RateLimiter({ max: 3, windowMs: 1000, mode: 'sliding', now: clock.now })
126	
127	    expect(limiter.allow('k')).toBe(true)
128	    expect(limiter.allow('k')).toBe(true)
129	    expect(limiter.allow('k')).toBe(true)
130	    expect(limiter.allow('k')).toBe(false)
131	
132	    clock.set(1001)
133	    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
134	      expect(limiter.allow('k')).toBe(true)
135	    }
136	    expect(limiter.allow('k')).toBe(false)
137	  })
138	})
139	
140	describe('RateLimiter — default clock', () => {
141	  it('uses Date.now when no clock provided', () => {
142	    const limiter = new RateLimiter({ max: 1, windowMs: 10_000, mode: 'fixed' })
143	    expect(limiter.allow('x')).toBe(true)
144	    expect(limiter.allow('x')).toBe(false)
145	  })
146	})
